title: Bug: Unable to handle templated sai.profile.j2 in link local
author: dakotac-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

test_link_local_ip.py assumes every DUT has a sai.profile file at /usr/share/sonic/device/<platform>/<hwsku>/sai.profile.
Some platforms only provide sai.profile.j2, which must be rendered with sonic-cfggen 
before the test can read SAI_NOT_DROP_SIP_DIP_LINK_LOCAL.

When only the template exists, the test raises an exception trying to cat the missing file instead of correctly determining whether link local forwarding is supported.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the test on a device using sai.profile.j2 for example https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/device/arista/x86_64-arista_7060x6_64pe_b/Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-O128/sai.profile.j2


### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected behaviour is the test checks if SAI_NOT_DROP_SIP_DIP_LINK_LOCAL is supported and then skips or runs the test.
Actual behaviour is raises an exception trying to cat a file that doesn't exist.

### Relevant log output

```shell
ip/link_local/test_link_local_ip.py:63: in check_if_test_is_supported
    for line in duthost.command("cat %s" % sai_profile)["stdout_lines"]:
                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
        duthost    = <MultiAsicSonicHost qspf215>
        hwsku      = 'Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-O128'
        platform   = 'x86_64-arista_7060x6_64pe_b'
        sai_profile = '/usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-arista_7060x6_64pe_b/Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-O128/sai.profile'
        sai_settings = {}
common/devices/multi_asic.py:404: in _run_on_asics_wrapper
    return self._run_on_asics(attr, *module_args, **complex_args)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
        attr       = 'command'
        complex_args = {}
        module_args = ('cat /usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-arista_7060x6_64pe_b/Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-O128/sai.profile',)
        self       = <MultiAsicSonicHost qspf215>
common/devices/multi_asic.py:161: in _run_on_asics
    return getattr(self.sonichost, multi_asic_attr)(*module_args, **complex_args)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
        complex_args = {}
        module_args = ('cat /usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-arista_7060x6_64pe_b/Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-O128/sai.profile',)
        multi_asic_attr = 'command'
        self       = <MultiAsicSonicHost qspf215>
common/devices/base.py:167: in _run_wrapper
    return self._run(module_name, *module_args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
        kwargs     = {}
        module_args = ('cat /usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-arista_7060x6_64pe_b/Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-O128/sai.profile',)
        module_name = 'command'
```

comments.body: not sure if this is right fix, should we fail the case if the expected profile not in place other than skip? @dakotac-arista

comments.author: dakotac-arista
comments.body:
> not sure if this is right fix, should we fail the case if the expected profile not in place other than skip? @dakotac-arista

Hi @StormLiangMS, thanks for taking the time to review. I originally had it as a pytest fail and I found that some HWSKU have different sai.profile paths E.g https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/tree/master/device/arista/x86_64-arista_7280dr3a_36/Arista-7280DR3A-36. Given that this test is unsupported for most devices I figured it would be less intrusive to just make it a skip.
